events.title: Turing AI & Deep Learning National Symposium 2026
events.venue: Central Auditorium & Computer Center, PEC Campus
events.description: Flagship annual innovation symposium on deep learning architectures, multimodal LLMs, and edge vision models. Features mentor sessions and prize grants.
rules: Teams of 2 to 4 members from authorized engineering colleges.
Original problem statements mapped to Industry 4.0 pillars.
Working prototype and live repository demonstration required.

events.title: Autonomous Robotics & Embedded ROS Workshop
events.description: Hands-on session on kinematics, robotic manipulators, ROS Gazebo simulations, and Arduino/ESP32 motor interface calibration.
rules: Individual registration or pairs.
Bring laptop with Ubuntu 22.04 or virtualized ROS container.

events.title: Cloud Native Kubernetes & Microservices Masterclass
events.description: Containerized services, Docker multi-stage builds, Kubernetes pod lifecycle, and CI/CD pipelines.
rules: Basic Linux familiarity expected.
Docker Hub account required for lab pushes.

events.title: Cyber Defense CTF: Penetration Testing League
events.description: College-wide ethical hacking capture the flag challenge covering web security, network packet analysis, reverse engineering, and cryptography.
rules: Zero malicious activity outside the designated sandbox network.
Points awarded for valid cryptographically signed flags.

events.title: Smart Edge IoT & LoRaWAN Industrial Hackathon
events.description: Connecting long-range LoRa edge nodes with cloud gateways for real-time agricultural telemetry and smart campus environmental monitoring.
rules: Teams of 2 to 3 members.
Hardware toolkits will be provided in lab sessions.

events.title: Electric Vehicle Battery Management & Telemetry Bootcamp
events.description: Deep dive into EV lithium-ion battery state-of-charge algorithms, regenerative braking dynamics, and CAN bus telemetry interfacing.
rules: Open to all EEE, ME, and ECE engineering undergraduates.

events.title: Smart Micro-Grid & Renewable Energy Hackathon 2026
events.venue: EEE Smart Grid Research Lab, PEC Campus
events.description: Designing smart energy monitoring IoT architectures, micro-grid balance controllers, and solar telemetry dashboards for campus sustainability.
rules: Teams of 2 to 4 students from any discipline.
Demonstration with simulation or micro-controller hardware required.

events.title: Smart Water IoT Sensors & Conservation Ideathon
events.description: Developing low-cost ultrasonic and turbidity IoT sensor networks for automated campus water auditing, leak detection, and recharge tracking.
rules: Interdisciplinary team projects encouraged.

events.title: EcoTech Circular Campus Waste Automation Challenge
events.description: Prototyping automated solid waste segregation sorting systems using embedded edge computer vision, mechanical sorting chutes, and recycling tracking.
rules: Working scale model or prototype demonstration required.

events.title: Pragsoft Full-Stack Open Source Code Sprint
events.description: 36-hour sprint contributing to open source repositories, modern full-stack web applications, and developer CLI tools under industry mentors.
rules: Individual coders or pairs.
GitHub repository commits tracked live.

events.title: Web3 & Spatial Metaverse Virtual World Hackfest
events.description: Build spatial audio environments, multi-user WebXR avatars, and decentralized campus digital twin exhibits for engineering walkthroughs.
rules: Browser-compatible 3D experiences or VR headset builds.

events.title: IETE VLSI & Edge Signal Processing Symposium
events.description: Technical symposium on Verilog/SystemVerilog RTL synthesis, FPGA prototyping, and edge acoustic signal processing for autonomous systems.
rules: Open to all ECE, EEE, and CSE students.

events.title: Green Building & Sustainable Civil Infrastructure Conclave
events.description: Expert keynote presentations on net-zero energy design, IGBC/LEED green building metrics, and low-carbon cement composites.
rules: Open to all PEC students.
